summary: A tactical RPG centered on the original PlayStation release and its Nintendo DS remake, Hoshigami: Ruining Blue Earth Remix.

entries.title: Hoshigami: Ruining Blue Earth

emulation.emulator: melonDS or DeSmuME; DuckStation for original comparison
emulation.notes: Use DS emulation for the main run; preserve dual-screen layout or a readable vertical layout for stream capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Nintendo DS asset resolution with emulator scaling.

primary.why: The DS remake is the most complete documented version, adding revisions such as a new difficulty, localization changes, extra endings, a new character, and DS-specific interface features.
primary.how_to_play: Use a Nintendo DS copy or melonDS/DeSmuME with legally dumped files; use the PlayStation original only if you specifically want the original 32-bit presentation.

all_releases.fidelity: Original 32-bit release; can be upscaled cleanly in DuckStation.
all_releases.reason: skip: historically important original, but the DS Remix is the more complete version because it adds documented remake content and revisions.

all_releases.fidelity: Handheld remake with DS interface and added content; emulator scaling is limited by DS assets.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete documented version, despite lower raw display fidelity than upscaled PlayStation emulation.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: DuckStation can make the PlayStation original look cleaner, but the DS Remix is more complete because it adds remake-specific content and revisions.

entries.remaster_caveats: The DS version is a remake/remix, not a high-resolution remaster; expect DS-era presentation.
